LESSON: MASS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.2: Mass
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, part of Measurement in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: How can you make a 1kg mass using a beam balance?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mass together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners identify who they are, as they role play in pairs or in groups, adding mass in kilograms using items in the

classroom model shop.

Values:
Integrity: Learners in groups or in pairs, display honesty in measuring mass of different objects in kilograms using a beam balance and

share their findings with others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: Learners collect safe materials to be used to measure mass in their immediate environment.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate skills used in preparing mass of different object to molding in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

Masses of 1kg, soil, sand, beam balance
